messages.text: Norris beats Antonelli with 'masterpiece' to take Spanish GP pole

metadata.summary: Lando Norris produced a stunning lap to beat Kimi Antonelli to the first pole position at Formula 1's all-new Madring circuit in a thrilling Spanish Grand Prix Qualifying.
metadata.content: Spanish GP: Lando Norris beats Kimi Antonelli to first pole position at Madring after thrilling qualifying finale | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to content Spanish GP: Lando Norris beats Kimi Antonelli to first pole position at Madring after thrilling qualifying finale Lando Norris edges Kimi Antonelli by 11 thousandths of a second to claim first Madring pole; Max Verstappen beats Lewis Hamilton to third; watch the Spanish Grand Prix from the all-new Madring circuit live on Sky Sports F1 at 2pm on Sunday, with build-up from 12.30pm Saturday 12 September 2026 18:12, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from qualifying for the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix. Lando Norris produced a stunning lap to beat Kimi Antonelli to the first pole position at Formula 1's all-new Madring circuit in a thrilling Spanish Grand Prix Qualifying. The McLaren driver hadn't appeared to be in contention for pole at any point of the session, but found a huge amount of pace on his final run to edge out championship leader Antonelli by 11 thousandths of a second. Max Verstappen, who had surged into pole contention earlier in the session, edged out Lewis Hamilton for third after the Ferrari driver produced a strong recovery having crashed in final practice earlier on Saturday. messages.text: USA pull level with Europe at Solheim Cup after late Kupcho heroics

metadata.summary: Team Europe are tied 8-8 with Team USA heading into the Sunday singles at the Solheim Cup, after Maja Stark and Linn Grant continued their perfect start and Charley Hull and Lottie Woad struggled again.
metadata.content: Solheim Cup 2026: Team USA pull level with Team Europe in fourballs after late Jennifer Kupcho magic at Bernardus Golf | Golf News | Sky Sports Skip to content Solheim Cup 2026: Team USA pull level with Team Europe in fourballs after late Jennifer Kupcho magic at Bernardus Golf Jennifer Kupcho found two late birdies to snatch victory for her and Lindy Duncan over Carlota Ciganda and Celine Boutier; Team USA won three points in fourballs to sit tied 8-8 with Team Europe heading into final day; watch the Sunday singles live from 9am on Sky Sports Golf By Ali Stafford at Bernardus Golf Saturday 12 September 2026 19:02, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of the Saturday fourballs from the Solheim Cup at Bernardus Golf, where Team USA pulled level with Team Europe Team Europe are tied 8-8 with Team USA heading into the Sunday singles at the Solheim Cup, after Maja Stark and Linn Grant continued their perfect start and Charley Hull and Lottie Woad struggled again. Anna Nordqvist's side tied both sessions on Friday before winning three of the four points on offer in the morning foursomes , giving them the advantage, only for Team USA to edge the afternoon fourballs and set up a thrilling final day. Stark and Grant delivered again as they claimed an impressive 2&1 win over unbeaten duo Megan Khang and Lauren Coughlin, their third win in as many sessions together, as Hull and Woad fell to a final-hole loss to Yealimi Noh and Andrea Lee. Charlton maintained their unbeaten home record this season with a 0-0 draw against Portsmouth. The Championship encounter may have lacked goals, but it was not devoid of entertainment, particularly in an open second half. The hosts were the better side in the opening 45 minutes and had the big chances to break the deadlock. Millenic Alli, who spent the second half of last season on loan with the visitors, volleyed over from close range from a perfect left-wing cross by Tyreece Campbell in the 32nd minute. That came soon after Portsmouth goalkeeper Daniel Bielica used his legs to repel a fierce strike from Karlan Grant
